title: Odd number of cupcake liners
text: Odd number of cupcake liners. My liners came in a set of 10, but one had a small hole in the bottom rendering it unusable. Since most of my muffin or cupcake mixes fill more than 9 liners, I needed to use some of my paper liners also. I couldn't find anything in the description regarding how many liners come in this pack, otherwise I would have chosen a different set. I don't think I'd recommend this set because of that. Cleanup was easy, I washed them by hand. I'll probably buy a different set of silicone liners to use them with this set in the future.
